worldcombat.skill.smog.summary: The user inhales and breathes a low cone of filthy smog in the chosen direction; it rolls along the ground, sweeping the near band first and the far band a beat later, and everyone it touches takes a little damage and is very likely poisoned. Short range and low damage, but the highest poison chance. Billow style is wider, farther and more poisonous at the cost of a lighter pass and a slower roll.
worldcombat.skill.smog.use.0: Poison whoever stands in front at close range
worldcombat.skill.smog.use.1: Plug the mouth of a corridor
worldcombat.skill.smog.use.2: Spam poison with its deep PP
worldcombat.skill.smog.description.0: The cone opens %2$s degrees wide and each foe it touches takes about %1$s damage; the target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.smog.description.1: The smog rolls up to %1$s blocks; those it touches have a %2$s poison chance.
worldcombat.skill.smog.description.2: It sweeps the near band first, then the far band %1$s s later; each band settles once.
worldcombat.skill.smog.billow.on: Billow style on: ×1.2 cone angle, ×1.15 range and ×1.15 poison chance, at ×0.85 damage per band and a slower roll.
worldcombat.skill.smog.billow.off: Billow style off (Sharp breath): a tighter, denser cone with ×1.15 damage that comes out faster.
worldcombat.skill.smog.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.smog.growth.0: At level %1$s the smog rises to %2$s power and %3$s degrees wide.
worldcombat.skill.smog.growth.1: At level %1$s the smog rises to %2$s power and the poison chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.smog.preference.billow: On: ×1.2 cone angle, ×1.15 range and ×1.15 poison chance, at ×0.85 damage per band and a slower roll, for covering a group. Off (Sharp breath): a tighter, denser cone with ×1.15 damage that comes out faster, for poisoning one target precisely.
worldcombat.skill.smog.preference.ai.max: Only foes within this distance become breath candidates; the shared approach logic then walks the companion into breath range. Higher starts the chase earlier.
worldcombat.skill.smog.preference.ai.see: On, an already poisoned foe is not a candidate: another breath only refreshes the poison. Off breathes at poisoned foes too.
worldcombat.skill.smog.preference.ai.clu: On, the companion prefers the breath when another foe stands within 3 blocks of the target, coating the group; off keeps the normal attack order.
worldcombat.skill.smog.preference.ai.lea: On, the companion may leave its post to breathe at a target; off restricts it to breaths it can make from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.smog.description.poiso: The poison lasts %1$s, draining health over time without defeating the target, and can be cured; Poison-type, Steel-type and suitably immune targets are not poisoned.
worldcombat.skill.smog.description.targe: One breath coats at most %1$s enemies, and each is settled only once.
